summary.zh-CN: 训练集是直接参与模型参数学习的数据。模型在这些样本上做前向传播、计算[[term:loss-function|损失]]和[[term:gradient|梯度]]，[[term:optimizer|优化器]]再根据梯度更新权重，因此训练集表现只能说明模型对已用于学习的数据拟合得怎样。
summary.en-US: The training set directly participates in learning model parameters. The model performs forward passes, computes [[term:loss-function|loss]], and obtains [[term:gradient|gradients]] on these samples; the [[term:optimizer|optimizer]] then updates the weights. Training-set performance only shows how well the model fits data used for learning.

coreConclusion.zh-CN: 训练集负责让模型学参数，不能单独证明模型对新数据也有效。
coreConclusion.en-US: The training set teaches the model its parameters, but cannot by itself prove that the model works on new data.
